name: Voxelab
summary: Budget consumer sub-brand of Zhejiang Flashforge 3D Technology Co., Ltd., best known historically for the Aquila printer line. Voxelab is a label rather than an independent extruder: its filament is manufactured by Flashforge in China, a relationship that is owner-verified, self-disclosed on Voxelab's own about page, and even visible in the brand's Amazon storefront name ('Voxelab Official: Flashforge 3D Printer'). Manufacturing countries here therefore reflect Flashforge's Zhejiang facilities.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md; corroborated by Voxelab's own about page ('a subsidiary brand of the premium 3D Printers developer Flashforge') and by the Amazon storefront name.

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Marketed as UV, rain and heat resistant

additional_notes: Confirmed filament SKUs are limited to PLA and ASA in this research pass; a fuller PETG/ABS/TPU catalog is plausible given the Flashforge parent but was not confirmed. Aquila printers ship with and sell removable spring-steel build surfaces, consistent with the Flashforge accessory lineup. No separate registered corporate address was found — Voxelab operates under the Flashforge corporate umbrella.

provenance.conflicts: Full material catalog beyond PLA and ASA is unconfirmed. Voxelab's separate legal/registered entity details (if any) distinct from Flashforge could not be established.
